name: chart-breaker-wrap
description: Android wrapper for Chart Breaker. The game itself is still one index.html with no build step; this folder exists only to put it in an APK.

scripts.sync: npm run copy && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.bundle: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
